title: Payment service DB connection pool exhausted
symptoms: HikariPool-1 Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. Checkout requests return HTTP 500. Active database connections pinned at the maximum with many threads waiting for a connection.
rootCause: A release added a repository method that did not close its connection on the exception path, leaking connections until the pool was exhausted.
resolution: Rolled back to the previous release. Fixed the leak with try-with-resources. Enabled Hikari leakDetectionThreshold. Added an alert on pending connection requests.

title: Order service OutOfMemoryError from unbounded cache
symptoms: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space. Pods restart repeatedly with OOMKilled. Heap usage climbs steadily after each restart and GC time increases.
rootCause: A product lookup cache had no size limit or expiry, so it grew with every distinct key until the heap filled.
resolution: Restarted pods to restore service. Replaced the map with a bounded Caffeine cache with expiry. Added a heap usage alert and a heap dump on OOM.

title: Auth service 401 spike after signing key rotation
symptoms: Sudden spike of HTTP 401 responses. JWT signature verification fails for valid users. Started right after the identity provider rotated its signing keys.
rootCause: Services cached the JWKS public keys for 24 hours and did not refresh when an unknown key id appeared.
resolution: Forced a JWKS cache refresh on all instances. Changed the cache to refresh on unknown kid with a short TTL. Added a rotation runbook step to pre-publish new keys.

title: Inventory Kafka consumer lag and rebalance loop
symptoms: Kafka consumer group lag keeps growing. Partitions rebalance continuously. CommitFailedException: poll interval exceeded max.poll.interval.ms.
rootCause: A slow downstream call inside the consumer made batch processing exceed max.poll.interval.ms, so the broker kicked the consumer out and triggered repeated rebalances.
resolution: Reduced max.poll.records. Moved the slow call to an async worker pool with a timeout. Increased max.poll.interval.ms. Added consumer lag alerting.

title: API gateway 504 timeouts from slow query without index
symptoms: Clients receive 504 gateway timeout. The upstream orders endpoint is very slow. Database CPU is high and the slow query log shows a full collection scan.
rootCause: A new filter on the orders listing query had no supporting index, causing a full scan that saturated the database under load.
resolution: Created a compound index on the filter fields. Added a query timeout and pagination limit. Added a slow query alert.

title: Notification service retry storm on email provider rate limit
symptoms: Email provider returns HTTP 429 too many requests. The retry queue keeps growing and the same messages are retried immediately, making the rate limiting worse.
rootCause: Retries had no backoff or jitter and no circuit breaker, so each failure was retried at full speed and amplified the load on the provider.
resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter. Added a circuit breaker around the provider client. Capped the retry queue and respected the Retry-After header.

title: User service cache outage causes database stampede
symptoms: Redis connection refused. Cache hit ratio dropped to zero and database load tripled. Profile endpoints become slow.
rootCause: The Redis node ran out of memory and restarted. Every request then fell through to the database at once because there was no request coalescing or fallback.
resolution: Restored Redis with a larger memory limit and eviction policy. Added request coalescing and short-lived local caching. Added a Redis memory alert.

title: Search service CPU saturation from regex backtracking
symptoms: CPU at 100 percent on all instances. Request threads are saturated and hung. Requests containing long query strings never return.
rootCause: A query sanitising regex with nested quantifiers caused catastrophic backtracking on long inputs.
resolution: Replaced the regex with a linear-time parser. Added a maximum query length and a request timeout. Added a thread pool saturation alert.

title: Payment partner TLS certificate expired
symptoms: javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path building failed when calling the bank partner API. Started exactly at midnight. All partner payments fail.
rootCause: The partner rotated to a new intermediate certificate and our truststore did not contain it, so the chain could not be validated.
resolution: Imported the new intermediate certificate into the truststore and redeployed. Added a certificate expiry monitor and a truststore update runbook.

title: Order service writes fail during MongoDB primary stepdown
symptoms: MongoNotPrimaryException: not primary. Writes fail for about a minute during the maintenance window, then recover on their own.
rootCause: A planned primary stepdown during maintenance caused a short election. The application did not use retryable writes, so in-flight writes failed.
resolution: Enabled retryWrites and a suitable serverSelectionTimeout in the connection string. Added retry with backoff for idempotent writes. Communicated maintenance windows.

title: Inventory node disk full from unrotated logs
symptoms: No space left on device. Writes fail and the service cannot start. Node disk usage at 100 percent and log files are very large.
rootCause: Debug logging was left enabled and log rotation was not configured, so log files filled the disk.
resolution: Deleted old logs and restarted. Configured log rotation with size and age limits. Reverted the log level to INFO. Added a disk usage alert at 80 percent.

title: Report service crash loop from missing environment variable
symptoms: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff right after a deploy. Startup fails with a missing required environment variable DATABASE_URL.
rootCause: The new release required a new configuration variable that was never added to the production deployment manifest.
resolution: Added the variable to the production config and redeployed. Added a startup config validation with a clear error. Added a deploy checklist step for new variables.
